original.statement: SummableFamily Γ R α} {g : Γ} {a : α} (ha : g = (s a).orderTop) (hg : ∀ b : α, ∀ g' ∈ (s b).support, g ≤ g') (hna : ∀ b : α, b ≠ a → (s b).coeff g = 0) : s.hsum.leadingCoeff = (s a).coeff g
